date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: Formal scope only: diplomats, approved officials and return-home travel were excepted. Earlier pandemic measures overlapped. The other three checkpoints and first actual ordinary traffic are not assigned this endpoint. A March 18 report attributes 4,414 land passages at these posts during March 13–17 to the Kyrgyz Border Service; 477 air travelers are excluded. Those counts establish reported use by the window, but not first passage of the previously barred Tajik cohort, all goods, or a continuous operational interval. Kazinform and Khovar cross-cite the same report.
